_comment: Preconfigured instances of the composite <bp-big-picture>. provider:'maplibre' flags each generated standalone page as TOKEN-FREE (see internal/generate-tree.mjs) so the element mounts INSTANTLY with no Mapbox token ladder — correct for this self-contained, mapless Cat-4 dashboard. generate-tree stamps the bundle's HEADLINE tag (bp-big-picture) on every instance page, so all preset instances render the COMPOSITE. The INNER elements (bp-research-header + the REAL cap-2 people-groups-grid) are individually embeddable via their own registered tags + SRI script (see manifest.elements and the staging index.html section 2, which wires them standalone through the DOM).

instances.title: Big Picture — research header ↔ people-groups grid (composite)
